question: ap1
prompt:
Each of your ideas must draw on a domain unrelated to the research question below, for example through an analogy, a structure, a principle, or a pattern borrowed from that domain, while still being a concrete, scientifically sound way to address the question.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Hysteresis loop mapping (magnetic materials analogy)
ideas.description: Borrowing from ferromagnet hysteresis, titrate a stimulus (e.g., TNF, serum, or optogenetic c-Fos/c-Jun induction) up and then down. Measure single-cell AP-1 activity and target-gene expression to test whether the response at identical input depends on prior history, and quantify loop area and decay time after stimulus removal.

ideas.title: Bistability and bimodality via dose-history phase diagrams (dynamical systems / Waddington landscape)
ideas.description: Use live-cell AP-1 reporters (e.g., FOS-GFP or AP-1 TRE reporter) with microfluidic pulses of varied duration, frequency and amplitude. Fit single-cell state-transition models to test whether AP-1 supports two stable attractors and whether transient pulses can flip cells permanently.

ideas.title: Chromatin 'scar' archaeology (stratigraphic dating)
ideas.description: Like dating layers in sediment, perform time-series ATAC-seq, CUT&RUN for AP-1 factors (FOS, JUN) and H3K27ac/H3K4me1, and Hi-C at intervals after stimulus withdrawal. Identify enhancers that remain accessible after AP-1 binding is lost, and test whether the persistence correlates with AP-1 motif density and with faster re-induction on rechallenge.

ideas.title: Acute degron 'erasure' test (circuit memory-wipe in electronics)
ideas.description: Analogous to cutting power to a memory circuit to see if state is volatile versus non-volatile, use dTAG/AID degron or dominant-negative A-FOS to rapidly deplete AP-1 after the initial stimulus and at various later times. Test whether a primed state and the faster second response persist without AP-1 (chromatin-based memory) or vanish (AP-1 self-sustaining memory).

ideas.title: Lineage-tracing 'pedigree' inheritance analysis (population genetics / heritability)
ideas.description: Time-lapse imaging of AP-1 reporter cells with lineage tracking, then compute mother-daughter and sister-cell correlations of AP-1 state across divisions, treating it like a heritable trait. Compare the decay of correlation to that of a non-heritable noise model, and perturb with cell-cycle arrest or CRISPRi of AP-1 positive-feedback loops (e.g., JUN autoregulation) to test mechanism.
